caption: The drawing features the head and upper chest of a carved sculpture, oriented at an angle with the chin pointing downward to the left. The carved figure depicts a person wearing a large, plumed hat, with the hat appearing weathered and patched with areas of flaking and darker discoloration. The colors used are primarily muted beiges, browns, and light earth tones, with subtle gradations indicating the texture and aged condition of the sculpture’s surface, including visible cracks and worn spots. The person’s hair is sculpted in segmented, curved lines beneath the hat. The face has a rounded, youthful appearance with a small, pointed nose and gently smiling lips, and the eyes appear slightly upturned. Around the neck, a ruffled collar is depicted with a button or similar circular fastener at the base. The background is plain and uncolored, with the sculpture resting against a wooden plank or frame rendered in shades of brown with woodgrain detail, which intersects diagonally from the lower right to upper left.
title: Figurehead from Schooner "Haroldine"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
